# `tfctl auth login`

The `tfctl auth login` command authenticates with HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl auth login [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl auth login` command authenticates the tfctl CLI with HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise. The CLI stores your token  in your active profile configuration, and uses it for all API calls that require authentication.

When `--token` is specified, the tfctl reads the token from standard input. Use this option for non-interactive environments such as CI/CD pipelines.

When `--token` is not specified, tfctl opens a browser to the token creation page for the configured hostname. The page prompts the user to copy and paste the generated token.

## Available options

The `tfctl auth login` command supports the following options.

| Option | Description | Default | Required |
|--------|-------------|---------|----------|
| `--token` | Read the token from standard input instead of prompting. When this flag is used, tfctl reads the token from stdin without opening a browser. | `false` | No |

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Examples

### Interactive login

Opens your browser to create a token, then prompts you to paste it:

```shell-session
$ tfctl auth login
```

### Login with token from stdin

Does not open a browser or prompt for input. Useful for CI/CD pipelines and other non-interactive environments:

```shell-session
$ echo my-token | tfctl auth login --token
```
